about: The crypt's bridge (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB2): a walkway of the crypt's stone across the dark between two rooms' sockets, west to east, its floor a 64 px band (a mouth's width) of the causeway's stones from end to end, its sides a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall). Its ends run to the template's edge, where its two sockets are (under `Sockets`, so any crack keeps clear of its mouths). Its floor is the causeway (content/grounds/causeway, CB12): narrow dressed stones laid across it in courses. tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_bridge_ground.tscn and its art from this.
